# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-07-07

## July 1, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.142.5 [NEW this scan]
- Bug fix: prevents full Responses WebSocket request payloads from being written to trace logs. Not reportable (bug fix / log-hygiene).

## June 29, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.142.4 [NEW this scan]
- Maintenance release, no user-facing changes. Not reportable.

## June 26, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.142.3 [NEW this scan]
- Maintenance-only patch, no user-facing changes. Not reportable.

## June 25, 2026 — Codex Remote GA + CLI 0.142.1 / 0.142.2 [reported prior scan]
- Codex Remote GA: mobile control of connected Mac/Windows hosts via authenticated one-to-one QR pairing (iOS/Android ↔ host).
- New DigitalOcean plugin: provisions a Droplet, configures SSH, connects it as a remote Codex workspace — cloud-provisioning connector.
- CLI 0.142.2: MCP tools use tool search by default; macOS auth honors system proxy/PAC/WPAD; dark-mode plugin logos; remote stdio MCP servers accept absolute native paths; PowerShell unlowered-AST commands require approval.
- CLI 0.142.1: Windows system proxy support (PAC, WPAD, static, bypass rules).

## June 18, 2026 — Record & Replay (macOS) + CLI 0.141.0 [prior scan]
- Record & Replay: demonstrated workflow → reusable skill (not in EEA/UK/CH at launch). Thread handoff local↔remote; bulk run-history actions.
- CLI 0.141.0: Noise-relay E2E-encrypted remote exec; per-thread plugin stdio MCP servers; realtime speech append/response control.

## June 16, 2026 — EEA/UK/CH regional expansion [prior scan]
- Computer Use, Codex Chrome extension, Memories, and Chronicle became available in EEA/UK/Switzerland.

## June 11, 2026 — Developer Mode Browser Use (CDP access) [reported 2026-06-12]
- Controlled Chrome DevTools Protocol access in Chrome + in-app browser; rate-limit reset banking + referral earning.

## June 2, 2026 — Sites plugin (preview) [reported 2026-07-06]
- Sites plugin entered preview: create, save, deploy, and inspect websites, dashboards, internal tools, web apps, and games hosted by OpenAI. New agent build/deploy surface + OpenAI-hosted deployment target.

## June 22, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.142.0 + ChatGPT iOS 1.2026.167 [prior scan]
- CLI: /usage credits; /plugins sections; configurable rollout token budgets; multi-agent delegation modes; indexed web-search mode; scheduled UTC reminders; exec-server survives disconnects; parental agents receive subagent errors.

## Older [prior scan]
- Jun 15 CLI 0.140.0 (minor); Jun 11 app 26.609 CDP browser use; Jun 9 CLI 0.139.0 (minor); Jun 9 iOS 1.2026.153 worktree/setup-script; Jun 8 CLI 0.138.0 desktop handoff; Jun 4 CLI 0.137.0 hosted web/image code-mode, multi-agent v2, remote-control pairing; Jun 1 Amazon Bedrock model provider.
